The load required to close the vent door without the lockpins
engaged is within the capability Of the cargo handlers. When
the vent door handle is closed and the lockpins are not engaged,
the lockpin tube will deflect and contact the lockpin limit
switch striker, giving a false door closed, latched, and locked
indication. Readjusting the lockpin tube assembly tO prevent the
vent door handle from being forced tO the closed position when the
lockpins are not engaged properly will provide a more positive and
reliable cargo door closed, latched' and locked system.
